name: EventLinqs growth plan
set_by: Lawal Adams (founder); written by the CONTROLLER
readable_version: Claude Doc 'EventLinqs: how I would win Australia' (claude.ai artifact MdszSQhvw32PFrfLmhtr9m)
mission: Australia's most complete weekly what's-on guide, with fair ticketing through it, in every locality.

layers: Featured photo cards: real, rights-recorded photos only
Directory: every checked event, by day, no image box
model.revenue_formula: Revenue = O x T x 12 x N + P
model.O: frequent paid organisers (sell paid tickets every month)
model.T: paid tickets each sells a month
model.N_note: A$35 ticket, 3.5% + A$0.99 booking fee assumed GST inclusive, less Stripe 1.65% + A$0.30; to be re-measured from real orders (GST, Connect, refunds, chargebacks, fee-free months)

founder_stretch.honest_note: At about A$1.18 a ticket this needs about 32 million paid tickets a year, more than all 31.4 million ticketed live performance attendances in Australia in 2024. It is reachable only with most revenue from promotions, organiser tools (Bookedproof) and markets beyond Australia. Tracked daily beside the plan; the gap is shown, never hidden.

scorecard_weekly: checked events in the next 14 days, per open city
share of listings with a real, rights-recorded photo
search visits to city and category pages

daily_quotas.outreach_note: Lawal's minimum since 19 October 2026, replies and follow ups counted; only where the Spam Act's inferred consent holds and the basis is recorded
daily_quotas.listings_rechecked: every event in the next 7 days and every one-off event, by risk

rollout_gates: A new state opens only when every open city meets its benchmark, paid tickets and subscribers grow four weeks in a row, and checking keeps up. Earliest: NSW and QLD Feb 2027; SA, WA, ACT Jul 2027; TAS, NT, regional towns 2028.
rules: Every price shown is the total with unavoidable fees
Nothing planned is reported as done
Every change to this file is a dated version, never an overwrite of history
